home.h1.zh:
為嚴苛應用而生的
精準光電元件

home.p.en: OKAYLIGHT delivers a full portfolio of LEDs, UV/IR sources, photodetectors and laser diodes — engineered for reliability across lighting, sensing and industrial systems.
home.p.zh: OKAYLIGHT 提供完整的 LED、紫外/紅外光源、光電探測器與激光二極管產品矩陣，為照明、感測與工業系統提供可靠保障。

band.p.en: Send us your specification — our team responds within one business day.
band.p.zh: 寄給我們您的規格，團隊一個工作日內回覆。

about.s1.en: OKAYLIGHT began as a components trading desk in Kowloon, serving the lighting industry's shift to solid-state sources. As customers' designs grew more demanding — UV curing modules, IR sensing arrays, precision laser alignment — we grew with them, moving from distribution into parameter-driven supply and application support.
about.s1.zh: OKAYLIGHT 從九龍的一個元件貿易櫃檯起步，服務照明業向固態光源的轉型。隨著客戶的設計愈發嚴苛——UV 固化模組、紅外感測陣列、精密激光對位——我們與他們一同成長，從分銷走向以參數為核心的供應與應用支援。

about.s2.en: Today we hold stock programs across nine product families and work directly with factories to control binning consistency. Whether you need 1,000 indicators or a recurring COB program, the same rule applies: the parameters you approve are the parameters you receive.
about.s2.zh: 今天，我們在九大產品系列持有常備庫存，並與工廠直接合作控管分檔一致性。無論您需要 1,000 顆指示燈，還是長期 COB 訂單，規則始終如一：您確認的參數，就是您收到的參數。
